host_processor_caches: L1d 6 MiB (128 inst), L1i 4 MiB (128 inst), L2 128 MiB (128 inst), L3 512 MiB (16 inst)
host_storage_capacity: 4x 1.92 TB NVMe SSD (5.3 TB XFS RAID volume) + NFSv4 shared storage
host_networking: 4x Ethernet, 4x InfiniBand HCA (not used: single-node submission)
host_memory_configuration: 24x 96 GB DDR5-6400 RDIMM (12 channels per socket), NPS4
accelerator_interconnect_topology: All-to-all within node (SPX compute partitioning, NPS1 memory partitioning)
hw_notes: BIOS: NPS4 memory domains per socket, SMT enabled, Power Determinism, PowerRegulator=StaticHighPerf, DataFabricCStateEnable=Disabled. Each rank pinned to the NUMA node of its GPU.
framework: AMD Primus with Megatron-LM (Llama 3.1 8B) / Megatron-Bridge (Llama 2 70B LoRA)
sw_notes: Lowest precision in linear layers: MXFP4. Micro-batch size 4 (gradient accumulation 1) for Llama 3.1 8B. NUMA affinity applied per rank. Dataset staged to node-local NVMe prior to the timed region; host caches dropped before every run.
